questions.prompt: What refutes an unrestricted universal claim?
questions.answer: One verified in-scope instance in which the claim fails.
questions.feedback: Check the definition and explain it in your own words before retrying.

questions.prompt: Does one exception refute a 90% frequency claim?
questions.feedback: Check the distinction or calculation against the worked case; correct the first unsupported step.

questions.answer: Changing the test or scope after contrary evidence without acknowledging the revision.
questions.feedback: State a concrete implication or limitation and retry without notes.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Constructs in-scope challenges and distinguishes universal from statistical claims.
scoring.transfer: Take three fictional claims with different logical scopes. Supply an appropriate challenge to each and document which claim changes and which remains unresolved.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; quiz score alone is insufficient.
